title: SARA: An Auditor-in-the-Loop LLM Recommender for Sustainability Reports
abstract: arXiv:2611.30839v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Auditing corporate sustainability reports requires assurance professionals to map a company-specific checklist drawn from roughly 1,700 regulatory requirements onto the relevant passages of lengthy, repeatedly revised draft reports and to judge compliance. We present SARA (Sustainability Reporting Assistant), a human-in-the-loop recommender system delivered as a Microsoft Word add-in that recommends, for each requirement, the passages addressing it and predicts a compliance verdict while keeping the auditor in full control. SARA casts auditing as content-based recommendation over a fixed regulatory taxonomy and makes per-requirement large language model (LLM) matching cheaper, faster, and more accurate through topic-prediction filtering: on expert-annotated reports, it reduces matching cost about sixfold and runtime by 42% versus feeding the full report to the LLM. translated_title: SARA：面向可持续发展报告的审计师在环LLM推荐系统
translated_abstract: 审计企业可持续发展报告需要鉴证专业人员将根据约1,700项监管要求制定的针对特定公司的检查清单，映射到篇幅冗长、反复修订的报告草稿中的相关段落，并判断其合规性。我们提出了SARA（Sustainability Reporting Assistant，可持续发展报告助手），这是一种人机协同的推荐系统，以Microsoft Word加载项的形式交付，能够针对每项监管要求推荐报告中的相关段落并预测合规判定，同时让审计师保持完全控制。SARA将审计任务建模为基于固定监管分类体系的内容推荐，并通过主题预测过滤使每项要求的大语言模型（LLM）匹配更廉价、更快速、更准确：在专家标注的报告上，与将完整报告输入LLM相比，它将匹配成本降低约六倍，运行时间减少42%。该系统已在普华永道德国的可持续发展鉴证业务中投入生产使用。
tldr: SARA是一种审计师在环的LLM推荐系统，以Word插件形式帮助审计师将监管要求匹配到可持续发展报告的相关段落并预测合规性，通过主题预测过滤将匹配成本降低约六倍、运行时间减少42%。
en_tdlr: SARA is an auditor-in-the-loop LLM recommender delivered as a Word add-in that matches regulatory requirements to sustainability report passages and predicts compliance, reducing matching cost about sixfold and runtime by 42% through topic-prediction filtering.
